NEW Emotes button has been added to the top of the screen. This is for those who have no mouths but must scream.

INSONI v2 update is accessible! Use the command "/insoniv2" to play. (BADGE AWARD NOT OBTAINABLE)

ABOUT:
You awaken in a dim padded room... it strikes a resemblance to an insane asylum cell from a facility. The walls pulse with a rhythm that mimics your heartbeat that it makes you feel uneasy. Something doesn't feel right and there's a lot of questions as to why you're here... Can you pull yourself together long enough from the insanity and break out of this prison?

Game creator: Stalkalek
INSONI (created since June 2019)
